name: 用量账本
author: JSJ189
description: 只读聚合本机代理的 SQLite 用量账本：请求数、成功率、TTFT 分布、时延、输出速率、token 用量与路由分布，并给出带来源与快照时间的估算成本；底栏显示今日请求数，点击打开看板。支持 EasyCLIProxyAPI 与任意兼容 usage_events schema 的账本。
descriptionEn: Read-only aggregation of the local SQLite usage ledger: requests, success rate, TTFT, latency, throughput, tokens and per-route cost, with estimated cost labelled by source and snapshot time. Works with EasyCLIProxyAPI and any ledger with a compatible usage_events schema.
